integrity: The primary preprint was inspected at the boundary homeomorphism, Fourier expansion, affine normalization, coefficient-tail formulas, rational self-convolution derivatives, and Jacobian test. The variable-parameter formulas were reconstructed exactly. A standalone exact-rational Bernstein checker certifies every continuum polynomial-sign assertion and the decimal root bracket; no sampled computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the fixed witness \(x_0=-99/100\) along the one-parameter ray \(a=-10/11\), \(0\le b<1/43\). It does not prove that \(\beta_*\) is the global first parameter at which local univalence fails somewhere in the disk, and it does not classify the full two-parameter stability region.
title: Exact parameter threshold for the Dorff counterexample’s rational witness
